scope: New root-owned test only; no production driver/composer, modifications to spare models, boot packet, firmware payload or real device operations.
source_set_format: sha256 two spaces leaf-relative path LF, sorted by path; own report and logs excluded

composition.owner: One static TEST context holds one mapping, one logical source and one ring; duplicate claim refused before and after close. Not a production allocator or cross-object exclusivity proof.
composition.preflight: Test-only PHY reset/clock predicate precedes every endpoint path in this fixture. Cold-reset test stops after one read, no endpoint access/write/fw callback/map/source/ring binding.
composition.identity_firmware: Fabricated PCI/chip identity, numeric_profile_verified=0, revision5 B3 names; required executable canonical fallback and optional board-data absence. No files, downloads or bytes.
composition.DART_ring_link: Actual original codec translates supplied synthetic IOVA to numeric PA with READ permission; WRITE and wrong SID refused. Ring label equals that tested IOVA, no CPU pointer conversion or actual buffer-backing proof.
composition.transport_phase: BCT_SHARED retained; separate mailbox setup/post branch is not exercised because its phase excludes the existing ring API.
composition.submission: Real fake-ring implementation; callbacks check buffer before producer/index readback before doorbell. Both normal and DAR endpoint bell variants tested. Not true16-bit atomic access or publication/coherence proof.
composition.completion: Direct ordinary-RAM synthetic consumer advancement plus explicit logical interrupt injection/dispatch. No firmware, DMA, MSI transaction, AIC ISR or actual completion.
composition.cleanup: Logical ring/source close only. Owner, descriptor, data and DART storage retained even on success. Reset after producer commit or pending event prevents completion; dirty/fault state retained without retries/rollback/free.
composition.fault_lifetime: Assertions hold within each test episode. Fresh ordinary-RAM fixture between independent fault cases is test isolation, not a recovery API.

modes: host-compiled KERNEL zero-I/O gate, not SDK

initial_unqualified_run.failure: lost-owner mutant survived because ownership assertion was before the mutated assignment. No count claimed from that run. Added post-finish owner and duplicate-claim assertions, final six compiled mutants fail assertions.

hardware_state.unchanged: Prior readonly PHY_NOT_READY observation with failed7/10 qualification and separate verified Linux recovery remains authoritative. No actor, retry, initialize or new boot admitted.

remaining_gaps: Physical PHY/power/link admission under compiled-out shared writes
Genuine numeric chip/core/firmware identity and calibrated board metadata
Real IOMapper backing, barriers,16-bit access and device drain
Actual firmware initialization, protocol item schema, completions and network stack
